rules.name: One home screen per thing
rules.statement: Every thing the map records belongs to exactly one screen.
rules.risk: Two screens claiming one thing send a reader to different places for the same answer.

sites.why: Picks, for each kind of thing, the single screen that draws it.
Reads that same choice to decide which tab a thing's own page sits under.
Sends a page about one thing to the tab that thing lives under.
Tells the map builder that a link to a thing lands on that thing's home screen.

rules.name: Ordinary case wears no label
rules.statement: A label that would be true of nearly every card is left off.
rules.risk: A word on every card separates no card from another, so the cards that differ stop standing out.

sites.why: Leaves off the word saying who a feature serves when the answer is the ordinary one.
Gives a person on the customer's side no word saying whose side they are on.

rules.name: Nothing said twice on one screen
rules.statement: A screen leaves off a fact it already shows beside the same thing.
rules.risk: Saying one fact twice fills the screen with dead words, so the reader stops reading carefully.

sites.why: Drops a card's sentence when the sentence only repeats the card's own name.
Drops the feature line when the path above the page already names that feature.
Skips a group heading that would only repeat the section heading above it.

rules.name: Colour and mark replace the type word
rules.statement: A box drops the type word wherever its colour and mark already say what kind of thing it is.
rules.risk: Printing the word on every box widens a large picture until it no longer fits a screen.

sites.why: Prints the type word only for the box sizes that ask for it, and for every interface.
Asks for the small box on a flow picture, which carries no type word.
Tells the map builder to colour each box on a flow picture by its kind.

rules.name: Empty screen is not offered
rules.statement: A screen is offered only when the map holds something to draw on it.
rules.risk: A tab opening onto nothing makes a small map look broken rather than small.

sites.why: Hides the decisions tab on a map that states no decision.
Hides the interfaces tab on a map that records no interface.
Drops a whole group of tabs once every tab inside it has been hidden.
Works out from the map whether there is any interface for a tab to show.

rules.name: A gap is stated, never blank
rules.statement: Where the map records nothing, the screen says so instead of leaving empty space.
rules.risk: Blank space reads as a screen that failed, so a real gap in the map goes unnoticed.

sites.why: Says a feature reaches no outside service, rather than showing an empty block.
Says no flow step reaches this decision, rather than showing an empty block.
Says no flow comes through this interface, so no feature can be named here.

rules.name: A relation line never points at code
rules.statement: A line between two things offers no code link, because the place it names is only one example.
rules.risk: One example presented as the location claims the two things meet only there.

sites.why: Builds a relation row as plain text, with no link to a line of code.
Clears the file browser's highlighted row, so an earlier pick cannot read as this line's place.
Marks a line of code from a flow step's own place, never from a relation line.

rules.name: A flow picture draws only that flow
rules.statement: A picture of one flow draws only the connections that flow itself makes.
rules.risk: Drawing every known connection makes a reader believe this flow does things it never does.

sites.why: Builds each arrow from the flow's own steps, grouped by the pair of things they join.
Tells the map builder that the arrows are the flow's steps, never the general connection list.
